Street-Level (TSA)

Street-level placements meet people exactly where they walk, wait, and shop. Positioned on transit shelters, benches, and kiosks, this format puts your brand at eye level in busy pedestrian and commuter zones. The close range and repeated daily exposure make it one of the most cost-effective entry points in out-of-home advertising, ideal for building local familiarity and driving foot traffic to nearby locations.

Billboard Posters

The most popular out-of-home format in Canada, the horizontal billboard is versatile, instantly recognizable, and impossible to scroll past. Placed along high-traffic routes and busy intersections, it drives mass brand impressions and keeps your message in front of customers day after day. Its scale and simplicity make it a dependable workhorse for both broad awareness campaigns and focused local pushes.

  • Geo-targeted Campaigns
  • Detailed Analytics
  • Cost-Efficient

Transit Advertising

Transit advertising turns everyday journeys into brand impressions, reaching commuters and travelers on buses, trains, subways, taxis, and in airport terminals. Because your message moves through the city all day, it builds frequency and familiarity with audiences on the go. From full vehicle wraps to interior cards and station posters, transit offers flexible formats to match your budget and your audience’s daily routes.

  • Eye-Catching
  • Community Driven
  • Mobile

Superboards

Superboards command attention through sheer scale, dominating the most strategic high-traffic locations. Their oversized format makes your brand unmissable from a distance and leaves a lasting impression long after the drive home. Reserved for premium sites along major routes and gateways, superboards are the format of choice when you want maximum visibility and a statement-making presence.

  • Massive Exposure
  • High-Traffic Locations
  • Drive Website Traffic

From a single landmark billboard to a fully coordinated out-of-home program, Kosick Communications helps brands own the streets where their customers live, commute, and shop. With more than 40 years buying media across Canada, we secure premium billboard, transit, and digital placements in Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, and high-traffic markets nationwide. Outdoor advertising still does something no other channel can match: it puts your message in the physical world at full scale, impossible to scroll past or skip. The difference between a forgettable placement and one people remember comes down to location, timing, and creative, and our team manages all three. We study traffic patterns and audience data to choose sites with real impact, negotiate rates directly with media owners to protect your budget, and handle creative production so every panel looks its best. Whether you want to dominate a single neighbourhood, build awareness across a province, or launch a national campaign, we turn physical space into measurable brand attention and lasting recall.

Have Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Billboard costs vary by format and location. Street-level placements start from approximately $550/month, classic billboard posters from $900/month, transit advertising from $1,000/month, and superboards from $1,500/month. Premium high-traffic locations command higher rates. We negotiate the best rates across our vendor network.

We analyze traffic volume data, demographic profiles, commuter patterns, and proximity to your points of sale. Our team maps competitor placements and identifies high-impact locations that align with your target audience and campaign objectives.

Most outdoor campaigns run a minimum of 4 weeks, which is the standard posting period. However, digital out-of-home can offer shorter commitments. We recommend 8-12 week campaigns for optimal brand recall and frequency.

Yes. We measure impression counts, traffic lift studies, website traffic correlation, QR code scans, and custom URL visits. Post-campaign reports include brand awareness metrics and recommendations for future placements.

We support all standard out-of-home formats including street-level displays, classic horizontal posters, vertical posters, superboards, transit wraps, digital screens, and specialty formats like wallscapes and murals. Our creative team can design for any specification.

Absolutely. Our in-house creative team designs high-impact billboard artwork optimized for quick readability, bold messaging, and brand consistency. We handle everything from concept to print-ready files and digital asset delivery.
